en.p: For a cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient $\dfrac{1}{2}$ and a real number $t$, let $g(t)$ be the number of real roots of the equation $f'(x)=0$ in the closed interval $[t,\,t+2]$. The function $g(t)$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) For every real number $a$, $\displaystyle\lim_{t\to a+}g(t)+\lim_{t\to a-}g(t)\le 2$.
